_help: "parts" maps a KSP1 part name (case-sensitive, as in its cfg) to the KSP2 tech node id that should unlock it. "ksp1_nodes" maps a KSP1 tech node id (any case) to the KSP2 tech node id that should take all its parts. Both win over tech_mapping.json; an id missing from the game's tree is ignored and logged.
